problem_parameters.n_nodes: <int> Total number of nodes including the depot source, all customers, and the depot sink.
problem_parameters.n_customers: <int> Number of customers that must be served.
problem_parameters.vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum total demand that a single vehicle can carry on one route.
problem_parameters.planning_horizon: <int> Latest time by which all vehicles must return to the depot.
problem_parameters.travel_cost_type: <str> Method used to compute travel cost between every pair of locations.
problem_parameters.travel_time_type: <str> Method used to compute travel time between every pair of locations.

nodes.id: <int> Unique index of this node in the node list.
nodes.type: <str> Role of this node: 'depot_source' for the starting depot, 'customer' for a delivery location, or 'depot_sink' for the return depot.
nodes.x: <float> Horizontal coordinate of this node in the two-dimensional plane.
nodes.y: <float> Vertical coordinate of this node in the two-dimensional plane.
nodes.demand: <int> Quantity of goods that must be delivered to this node.
nodes.service_time: <int> Time a vehicle must spend at this node once service begins.
nodes.time_window_open: <float> Earliest time at which service may begin at this node.
nodes.time_window_close: <float> Latest time at which service may begin at this node.
